entity.summary: Non-custodial peer-to-peer Bitcoin exchange using multisignature escrow to let buyers and sellers trade directly across many payment methods and currencies.
entity.notes: Current first-party pages describe a global non-custodial peer-to-peer Bitcoin marketplace using multisignature escrow and expose active offer, contract, and API workflows. Classified as dex under HEI's bounded type enum because users trade directly without exchange custody. No exact launch date, legal jurisdiction, predecessor, successor, terminal state, or incident event is asserted.

evidence.title: About Hodl Hodl
evidence.notes: First-party page describes Hodl Hodl as a global peer-to-peer Bitcoin trading platform that does not hold user funds and uses multisignature escrow, with broad currency support and substantial completed-deal and user counts.

evidence.title: Hodl Hodl API documentation
evidence.notes: Current first-party API documentation exposes active Bitcoin buy and sell offer, contract, and trading-data interfaces, supporting active classification.
